{
  "database": {
    "tables": [
      {
        "name": "bundles",
        "purpose": "Stores each bundle's identity, mode (fixed or flexible), enabled state, and system-managed health status.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",            "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "title",         "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "description",   "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NULL" },
          { "name": "mode",          "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "enum": ["fixed", "flexible"] },
          { "name": "enabled",       "sqlType": "BOOLEAN",     "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT false" },
          { "name": "health_status", "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'healthy'", "enum": ["healthy", "warned", "auto_disabled"] },
          { "name": "created_at",    "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" },
          { "name": "updated_at",    "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "indexes": [["enabled", "created_at"], ["health_status"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_items",
        "purpose": "Stores variant-level products belonging to each bundle, with last-observed availability.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                    "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "bundle_id",             "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE" },
          { "name": "variant_external_id",   "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "product_external_id",   "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "observed_availability", "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available'", "enum": ["available", "out_of_stock", "deleted"] },
          { "name": "added_at",              "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["bundle_id", "variant_external_id"],
        "indexes": [["variant_external_id"], ["bundle_id", "observed_availability"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_tiers",
        "purpose": "Stores each discount tier for a bundle: minimum item count, discount rate, and display order.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                 "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "bundle_id",          "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE" },
          { "name": "minimum_item_count", "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "discount_rate",      "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "discount percentage * 100, e.g. 1000 = 10%" },
          { "name": "display_order",      "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "created_at",         "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" },
          { "name": "updated_at",         "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["bundle_id", "minimum_item_count"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "display_order"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_purchase_records",
        "purpose": "Records bundle purchases from paid orders; keyed by order external id + bundle id for idempotency.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                    "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "bundle_id",             "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE" },
          { "name": "order_external_id",     "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "order_placed_at",       "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "variant_external_ids",  "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "JSON array of variant IDs selected at purchase time" },
          { "name": "item_count",            "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "discount_rate_applied", "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "discount percentage * 100" },
          { "name": "order_total",           "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "order total in minor units" },
          { "name": "order_currency",        "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD'" },
          { "name": "recorded_at",           "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["order_external_id", "bundle_id"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "order_placed_at"], ["order_placed_at"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_health_events",
        "purpose": "Logs every automated health change applied to a bundle for merchant audit.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                          "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "bundle_id",                   "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE" },
          { "name": "event_kind",                  "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "enum": ["auto_disabled", "warned", "cleared"] },
          { "name": "affected_variant_external_id","sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NULL" },
          { "name": "reason",                      "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "occurred_at",                 "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "occurred_at"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      }
    ]
  },
  "shopifyIntegration": {
    "webhookTopics": [
      "orders/paid",
      "inventory_levels/update",
      "products/update",
      "products/delete"
    ],
    "cronSchedule": null
  },
  "httpRoutes": {
    "admin": [
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/bundles",              "purpose": "Paginated list of bundles with status filter" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/create",       "purpose": "Create new bundle" },
      { "method": "PUT",  "path": "/admin/bundles/update",       "purpose": "Update bundle fields" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/remove",       "purpose": "Delete bundle" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/clone",        "purpose": "Clone bundle with items and tiers" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/bulk-status",  "purpose": "Bulk enable/disable bundles" },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/bundles/items",        "purpose": "List bundle items paginated" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/items/save",   "purpose": "Replace bundle items" },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/bundles/tiers",        "purpose": "List bundle tiers" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/tiers/save",   "purpose": "Replace bundle tiers" },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/purchase-history",     "purpose": "Paginated purchase history" }
    ],
    "widget": [
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/widget/bundle",           "purpose": "Fetch bundle config, tiers, items for widget" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/bundle/validate",  "purpose": "Validate customer selection and return earned tier" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/cart/add",         "purpose": "Add bundle to cart with discount applied" }
    ]
  }
}
